description: Complete the CODEREF-CORE unified-pipeline migration boundary without removing the live lightweight scanner: make PipelineOrchestrator generators the only writers of canonical .coderef artifact paths; quarantine or deprecate competing src/fileGeneration public writers while retaining shared index-storage and route serializers; resolve the ContextGenerator and package-entrypoint export split; remove the redundant coderef-scan leg from default pipeline and full-watch execution; classify and migrate remaining legacy scanner callers; and add compatibility, overwrite-contract, orchestration, build, and package-entrypoint tests. Out of scope: removing scanCurrentElements, removing shared index or route helpers, changing artifact semantics beyond contract normalization, or redoing the completed TreeSitterScanner retirement.
